title: Cancel closes the part window without saving
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANCEL-01), with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Cancel) and Sell Price $20.00, is stocked at {Location-A}.
  • The description you will type is {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL Cancel Changed).
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Replace the Description with {Description-B}.
  4. Replace the Sell Price with 99.00.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the window closes. The row still shows {Description-A} and Sell Price $20.00.
  • Step 6: the fields read {Description-A} and $20.00: nothing was saved.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R8, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (The part as it stands), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R8: “Cancel is the design system's secondary button: white, with a grey outline and dark label. It closes the dialog without saving.”
